body:
Me and my friend has drank a little bit wine in earlier evening and then decided to smoke some bud. But because we have so small dosage of it, I do some karsta (in Finland we have called) in it with buds. That black and stinky shit what hash or bud leave after smoking all round pipe.
Now we have a nice set of THC and I have a new idea about putting some shrooms in our mix. So I put about ten of them and immediately we smoked it. I remember that after smoking I put some music on and go to sofa and just lied about two hours there. It really kicked me. I went to the very dreamy mind state. For about couple of minutes I lost totally my eye contact with world. I was seeing only black with weird green things 'born' on the 'top' of that black what I was seeing. I thought that my eyes are closed, because that powerful imagination. But suddenly that black was gone and I noticed that those green 'things' was actually just my surrounding world shapes. It is important too, that my eyes was open all the time.
I think that this experiment was actually very good for me. I was working with my unconsciousness without any walls between my concsiousness and unconsciousness. All my negative feelings just floating to me and I accepted those and that gives me a totally freedom to do whatever I want with me and my feeling and thoughts.
And I feel absolutely euphoric all the time =) Like I was top of the soft clouds.
